name: Cell Projection with Texture Mapping for Opacity
aliases: Hardware-Assisted Polyhedron Projection with Texture Lookup
Hardware-accelerated Cell Projection with Texture Lookup
definition: A hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique where cell faces are projected as polygons, and opacity is computed via texture lookup to avoid per-pixel exponentials.
summary: Cell Projection with Texture Mapping for Opacity accelerates volume rendering by using hardware texture lookups to compute exponential transparency, avoiding Mach bands caused by linear interpolation.
